C0130.title: Woman Fakes Allergy to Scam Hotel Refunds, Detained for Malicious Refund Fraud
C0130.summary: In May 2025, a woman surnamed Wang in Shanghai, knowing she had an allergic constitution, deliberately scratched her skin and falsely claimed an allergic reaction to demand a hotel refund. To evade legal consequences, she repeatedly searched for content related to consumer disputes.
